svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Turn from 25 mm bar: a 20.0 mm diameter body 12 mm long

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with a 60 degree point below it (point 17.3 mm high), 29.3 mm overall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Keep the 20 mm diameter within 0.1 mm; a worn or undersize cone

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: biases the DCP index. Leave a sharp point, no flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top face: drill 10.2 mm 16 deep, tap M12 x 1.75 to 14 mm deep, and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: face it square to the axis: the rod shoulder bears on this face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Harden after tapping (about 50 HRC); run a tap through after.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: screws onto the M12 stud on the bottom of the lower rod with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: medium thread locker; the rod shoulder seats on the top face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: 20.0 mm across the body; 60 degrees with a gauge; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rod shoulder sits flat on the top face with no gap.
